notes.title: KAIDO
notes.text: SEED ROUND PRESENTATION. KAIDO. Next-Generation Workflow Automation for F&B and Retail SMEs in Southeast Asia. COMPANY Kaido Pte. Ltd. (Singapore). BACKED BY Antler Singapore. SEEKING S$2.5M Seed Funding
notes.visuals: The slide features a dark blue background with white and light blue text and vertical separator lines between the company details.

notes.title: The $4.5B Operational Friction for SMEs
notes.text: Fragmented Tools SMEs rely on 5–8 unintegrated software systems (POS, GrabFood/Foodpanda, Xero, inventory sheets), causing extreme operational silos. Manual Data Entry Store managers waste 15+ hours weekly re-keying sales figures, invoice totals, and inventory items manually, triggering high error rates. Margin Squeeze Rising labor costs and food inflation in Singapore/SEA eat away 18–25% of net profit, making manual ops financially unsustainable.
notes.visuals: The slide contains three white cards arranged horizontally, each featuring a small blue icon at the top: the first icon depicts stacked layers/chevrons, the second is a circular clock arrow, and the third shows an arrow pointing down next to a bar chart.

notes.title: THE SOLUTION Kaido: The Operating System for SMEs
notes.text: One Unified Hub: Connects POS, food delivery platforms, local banks, supplier orders, and accounting apps into an automated stream. Real-Time Triggers: Automatically syncs inventory levels, parses PDF invoices, and reconciles daily payments without manual intervention. Proven ROI: Saves F&B and retail store owners 60+ hours per month while slashing data errors by over 90%.
notes.visuals: A screenshot of a software dashboard featuring a navigation menu with multiple icons (Banks, Accounts, Receipts, Payments, Expenses, etc.), a 'Today's Status' section showing financial metrics (Total Purchase, Total Sale, Purchase Due, Sale Due, Expense), and a section displaying 'Total Users', 'Total Products', a bar chart titled 'Net Profit', and inventory statistics (Out of Stock Percent, Out of Stock, In Stock, Return Rate, Returned Amount, Returned Quantity).

notes.title: Built for Rapid Adoption & Zero-Code Automation
notes.text: No-Code Workflow Builder: Pre-packaged SEA automation recipes (e.g., GrabFood -> Xero daily payout entry, automated supplier PO trigger via WhatsApp/Email). Smart Supplier Ordering: Predictive inventory alerts automatically generate stock re-orders based on real-time sales velocity and historical consumption. Multi-Channel Reconciliation: Automated payment matching across PayNow, credit cards, and delivery app settlements directly to Xero & QuickBooks. 15-Minute Onboarding: Zero technical setup required. 1-click connectors for top regional POS platforms (StoreHub, Toast, Lightspeed, Meganex).
notes.visuals: Four distinct cards arranged in a 2x2 grid, each with an icon at the top: the No-Code Workflow Builder features a magic wand/sparkle icon, the Smart Supplier Ordering features a factory/building icon, the Multi-Channel Reconciliation features a document/ledger icon, and the 15-Minute Onboarding features a lightning bolt icon.

result.summary: Kaido is an automation platform for F&B and retail SMEs in Southeast Asia that connects fragmented software systems. The deck is well-structured, providing clear market sizing, traction, and unit economics, though it could benefit from a more explicit timeline for the GTM expansion.

criteria.evidence: Next-Generation Workflow Automation for F&B and Retail SMEs in Southeast Asia
criteria.justification: The cover clearly states the company name, its core value proposition, and the target market segment.
criteria.fix: Include a more concise 'one-liner' that is distinct from the descriptive subtitle to ensure instant clarity.

criteria.evidence: Store managers waste 15+ hours weekly re-keying sales figures, invoice totals, and inventory items manually
criteria.justification: The slide identifies the target customer (SMEs), specific pain points (manual data entry, fragmented tools), and the impact of the problem.
criteria.fix: Adding a testimonial quote from a specific store manager would further strengthen the credibility of the pain point.

criteria.evidence: Connects POS, food delivery platforms, local banks, supplier orders, and accounting apps into an automated stream
criteria.justification: The solution directly addresses the operational silos mentioned in the problem slide with a clear functional description.
criteria.fix: Include a brief user testimonial or use case study to demonstrate the solution in a real-world scenario.

criteria.justification: The deck does not explicitly state the timing argument or market shifts that make this specific time urgent.
criteria.fix: Add a slide detailing how recent shifts in regional digitization or specific labor market trends make this the optimal time for the launch.
